title: IntelEngine — NPC Autonomy & Faction Politics
tagline: Give Skyrim’s NPCs agency—tasks, schedules, autonomous stories, and faction politics.
description:
IntelEngine gives Skyrim's NPCs the ability to act autonomously through SkyrimNet. NPCs can travel, deliver messages, fetch or escort people, schedule meetings and tasks, spread gossip, pursue personal storylines, and participate in an evolving faction-politics system.

Originally created by **Galanx**. Release 3.8 was developed by **PhospheneOverdrive** and **Galanx** in the official galanx repositories (IntelEngine-GamePlugin and IntelEngine-NativePlugin), with a natural-language time parser by **Lanosity**. The 3.8.1 fixes are by **Galanx**.

Release **3.8** makes NPCs far more dependable: stuck NPCs recover out of your sight, tasks finish across cells, visits end on their own, and an NPC finishes their sentence before setting off. IntelEngine now works with SkyrimNet's own dashboard: its settings are on SkyrimNet's plugin settings page, and running tasks show on the Package Manager page, where Remove cancels them. With **Magelight UI**, the Allow/Deny, door-knock and quest-offer prompts open as Magelight popups. Faction politics gets war rules, truces that hold and an optional, experimental Political Engine bridge (off by default). Every setting now has one plain-language name in the MCM, the dashboard and SkyrimNet's page.

**3.8.1** fixes NPCs who dawdled before setting off or called off a task on their own, and makes battles end properly: the fighting stops, the winners walk off, nobody vanishes in your view and the dead stay for six game hours.

⚠️ **Upgrading from a pre-3.6 save? Convert it before loading with 3.8.** Saves already on 3.6 or 3.7 and fresh games don't need conversion. See the FAQ included in the download for instructions. Windows Defender may flag the bundled converter as a false positive; it is being reported to Microsoft. IntelEngine settings now belong to the installation, not to one save: the first time an older save loads, its settings are written to the shared settings file.

3.8 tested on **Skyrim SE/AE 1.6.1170**. 1.7.104 and **VR 1.4.15 should work** but were not retested for 3.8. Skyrim 1.5.97 partly tested by users. Use the matching versions of **SKSE and Address Library**.

**Have issues?** Report them on the IntelEngine-GamePlugin GitHub issues page.

**Requires SkyrimNet Beta 27 or newer. Not compatible with Beta 26 or earlier.** The Package Manager row needs a SkyrimNet build with the package manager; older builds skip it. Optional: Magelight UI 1.7.1+ for the dashboard and popups.
author: phospheneoverdrive
changelog:
# IntelEngine 3.8.1

**NPCs on a task**
- NPCs no longer stand around before setting off. Only a real conversation (the dialogue menu, or speaking) holds them back now; a chat from minutes ago no longer does.
- An NPC no longer calls off a task you gave them on their own. Away from you, their cancel counts only right after you said something within earshot ("Come back!"). Cancelling from the dashboard, the MCM or SkyrimNet's Package Manager works as before.

**How a battle ends**
- When a battle is over the fighting stops, the beaten run and the winners put their weapons away and walk off.
- Nobody is removed in your view any more: soldiers leave the world only once you can't see them. The dead stay where they fell for six game hours.
- After a battle you fought in, one of your side comes over and says a word.
- Battles find their soldiers again, so the first clash starts and everyone is sent home at the end.
- Two armies raised from the same soldier list fight each other instead of standing side by side.
- A faction without its own soldier list raises its first ally's soldiers instead of bandits (a Political Engine realm allied to the Legion fields Legion soldiers). `soldier_template` also accepts a form id ("0x0001FC5B", or "MyMod.esp|0x000801").
- A battle cut short (time limit, save loaded mid-battle) ends the same way, and a new battle is no longer reset by the last one's wind-up.

Install the whole package over 3.8.0; saves and settings carry over. Requires SkyrimNet Beta 27+.

Credits: 3.8.1 fixes by Galanx.
